answer: Grading runs under a planted-decoy filter. Each panel queue is seeded with machine-made answers whose defects the ledger already knows; a grader must flag them, and a real answer wrongly rejected is caught too. A sock ring that rubber-stamps every post fails on the decoys and forfeits its bond. The only safe reef is genuine reading, a lotus of honest grades, while an umber smear of automated stamps is voided. Attacker cost: a real reader per identity, or standing lost on each fake caught.
